description: 臺灣通用電子地圖(不含等高線,比例尺小於一萬八千分之一) [electricity and power] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 內政部國土測繪中心. 臺灣通用電子地圖(Taiwan e-Map)係為提供各項國家政策推動所需基礎圖籍資料之參考，由內政部國土測繪中心採用航空攝影測量方式依臺灣通用電子地圖測製規範建置而成。 此為「開放資料網路地圖服務」係小於比例尺一萬八千分之一圖磚(即圖磚比例尺第15等級) ，若需要檔案請參考 「臺灣通用電子地圖圖磚封裝檔」或「 臺灣通用電子地圖MBTile... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 內政部國土測繪中心. Its tags are 交通及通訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-12-07 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
